sections.name: Alien Grunt
sections.card:
Summary: A big armoured Xen soldier with 120 health. On Earth it fires hornets in rapid bursts and then charges in; on Xen it is more agile and can jump onto platforms.
Weak points: The unarmoured part of its torso: one crossbow bolt kills it there, even on Hard.
Looks like: Large and stocky, with a small extra arm on its chest. It stands more upright and wears more armour than the 1998 original.
Tips: Its hornets do not home in on you. A hornet hit does 9 damage and a punch 30. The kind with no armour and no Hivehand has none to fire and simply charges at you.

sections.name: Headcrab
sections.card:
Summary: A small parasite about the size of a person's head that leaps up to 3 metres (10 feet) at its target. It is the first enemy you meet.
Weak points: One crowbar hit or two Glock 17 shots kill it on every difficulty. After a missed leap it is in a bad position and turns round very slowly or tries to retreat.
Looks like: Smooth-skinned, with four short, strong legs. Its look is closer to the Half-Life 2 headcrab than to the 1998 one.
Tips: Some burrow into the ground and come out as you walk up, and its small size makes it hard to hit. Heavy props kill it, it drowns in water, and a flare sets it alight.

sections.name: Zombies
sections.card:
Summary: People taken over by headcrabs. They only fight up close, clawing for 20 damage a hit, and have 50 health. They come as scientists, guards and marines, plus a tougher suited kind.
Weak points: The suited kind is much tougher than the rest, and its head is the only part its suit does not cover.
Looks like: A person with a headcrab on the head and a body that is rotting open. Some are torsos that crawl; the suited kind wears an HEV suit.
Tips: They can punch props and objects so that they fly at you. Shots to some body parts stagger them, and a shot from chest to foot can leave the headcrab alive to leave its host. A flare sets them alight.

sections.name: Vortigaunt
sections.card:
Summary: An alien that dodges when you aim at it and uses a shockwave when you get close.
Looks like: Bent forward, with snail-like skin, a small extra arm on the chest and green rings round the neck and arms, like chains.
Tips: On Earth they are always hostile. In the Xen chapters they leave you alone, even if you provoke them, until an Alien Controller takes over their minds; they calm down again when it dies. Their ground slam kills snarks instantly.

sections.name: Barnacle
sections.card:
Summary: A creature that hangs from the ceiling and pulls up the props and people it grabs with its tongue. It has more health than in the 1998 game.
Tips: It takes three crowbar hits instead of one. Whatever it grabs is squeezed, so a victim cannot survive being freed. On Xen an underwater kind hangs upside down from the bottom; only the crowbar, Glock 17, crossbow, RPG, Hivehand and explosives kill it. One achievement is about a barnacle eating a headcrab ten times.

sections.name: Bullsquid
sections.card:
Summary: A spitting alien predator that stays calm until you come into its sight.
Looks like: Its eyes sit on the top of its head, like a water hunter's.
Tips: Its acid makes your suit warn of hazardous chemicals. Spit that lands in water slows down and stops, and touching a broken-up blob does no damage.

sections.name: Alien Controller
sections.card:
Summary: An alien that throws clusters of energy balls, dodges when you aim at it and can take over Vortigaunts' minds.
Looks like: Redesigned since the 1998 game, mostly in its glow, which shows orange while it lifts objects.
Tips: It teleports in when an alarm sounds. Crystals around it act as armour. Kill it and the Vortigaunts it controlled stop attacking.

sections.name: Black Ops assassins
sections.card:
Summary: Female Black Ops assassins fight with a Glock 17 in each hand and do not throw grenades.
Looks like: Black boots that look like Portal's long-fall boots, and pistols with no visible suppressor.
Tips: The pistols look unsuppressed but sound silenced. Their boots keep them from being hurt by falls. In the rooms where they wait they go hunting even if they have not seen you, then surround you, and there are more of them than in the 1998 game.
